fusions.name: Belly Landing
fusions.desc: Comes down on your full weight, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Throw Your Weight
fusions.desc: Throws your bulk into a target at the cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 10 damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Den Calm
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds. You take 10% less physical damage.

fusions.name: Fat for Winter
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you take 6% less physical damage.
